title: The signup code now writes each new user's email address into the logs
diff:
diff --git a/app/routes/signup.py b/app/routes/signup.py
--- a/app/routes/signup.py
+++ b/app/routes/signup.py
@@ -8,4 +8,5 @@
 def register(email: str, name: str) -> User:
     user = User(email=email, name=name)
     user.save()
+    logger.info("New signup: %s", user.email)
     return user
